top_signals.title: Treasury Yields Follow Oil Lower With Fed and Supply in Focus
top_signals.summary: US Treasuries edged higher as oil prices softened after the US paused its nearly two-week campaign of strikes against Iran, while traders eyed a roughly one-in-three chance of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike on Wednesday.
